process: MJF PA12 (JLC3DP: PA12-HP Nylon; PCBWay: MJF Nylon PA12)
tolerance_notes: +-0.2 mm. Bench pod shell + v0.1.0: USB-C opening 9.4 x 3.4 mm in the +X wall (0.4 mm web above), battery bay ribs (0.5 mm), motor contact shelf, USB board posts, board posts/pins, M1.2 pilots dia 1.0 (x6). Order the dock-insert set (bench `dock-inserts/`, same frozen interface) first. Porous: splash-level only.

process: SLA (JLC3DP clear / transparent resin, spec 2a: clear lid, no fill-window slot)
finish: wash + UV cure; no polish on the gasket seat
tolerance_notes: +-0.1 mm. Board, cell and LEDs are visible: keep the electronics tidy; optional light-blocking black ink / paint mask on the inside over the status LED only if needed. Lid features: piezo port dia 0.8 + membrane recess dia 4.0 x 0.2, button membrane 0.5 mm, pressure vent dia 0.8 + dia 5.0 x 0.2 recess (ePTFE disc). 0.5 mm membranes are at the printable floor: order 2.

process: SLA (JLC3DP: resin 8001 / 9000-type tough; PCBWay: SLA Somos/8000-type)
finish: support marks on the outside only; do not sand the hex pocket
tolerance_notes: +-0.1 mm (hex pocket AF 3.8 = DIN 934 M1.6 AF 3.2 + 0.6 clearance (0.3 mm radial float), closed rear wall + top drop-in slot, dia 1.9 screw bore, rail groove 1.2 x 0.5). Order 2: nut fit is the first test.

process: SLA
tolerance_notes: +-0.1 mm. Seal grooves (0.8 mm wide) + socket for carriage tongue. Water test only.

process: SLA (clear resin preferred, 'BioMed Clear'-class if offered, else standard clear)
finish: wash + UV post-cure; inner bore stays unpolished
tolerance_notes: WATER ONLY (SLA copy; the CNC PP part in reservoir-cnc/ is only a material preparation for a future manufacturer) - not sterile, not validated. +-0.1 mm; check bore 16.0 x 5.0 with a pin gauge; bore may need light honing. Single piece; open dry end.

process: SLA (tough resin; later PP / CNC)
finish: no coating; clear internal channels d0.7 with a 0.5 mm wire
tolerance_notes: +-0.05 mm. End cap pressed onto the d2.0 H7 port of the CNC reservoir (spigot d1.98 x 2.0): fill septum bore d4.2 (side), duckbill pocket d3.05 with open slot, needle guard tube d3.2 / bore d2.0, internal channels d0.7. WATER ONLY in SLA resin.

process: SLA (tough resin) - or turned brass tube (preferred)
tolerance_notes: +-0.05 mm. Sleeve coupler d3.0 x 6.0: D-bore d2.04 / flat 1.5 (3.2 deep) for the NFP shaft, M1.6 bore d1.64 (2.8 deep) for the leadscrew; retain with one drop of cyanoacrylate / Loctite 638. VERIFY the shaft D-flat on the real motor.

process: SLA (JLC3DP resin 8001-type)
tolerance_notes: +-0.1 mm. 0.7 mm stadium disc (14.6 x 3.6) glued (CA) onto the plunger front: dead layer 0.3 mm. WATER ONLY.

process: SLA (JLC3DP resin 8001-type)
tolerance_notes: +-0.05 mm. Press-fit plug (0.04 mm interference per side) that closes the duckbill insertion slot in the end cap; flush with the cap top.

process: SLA, or brass tube d2.0 x d1.6 x 2.05 (cut + deburr)
tolerance_notes: +-0.05 mm. Gear carrier and rear thrust shoulder: slides on the rod, rear face on the dry bush, GHW 753020 (bore 2.0) glued on it (Loctite 638). Printed d2.0 walls are thin: brass tube recommended.

process: SLA, or brass tube d2.4 x d1.6 x 1.0
tolerance_notes: +-0.05 mm. Front thrust shoulder at the rod end: bears on the far bush face; the magnet is glued to the rod end behind it and carries no thrust.

process: SLA (JLC3DP resin 8001-type; PCBWay SLA)
finish: support marks off the dome sides and the notches
tolerance_notes: +-0.1 mm. Dummy cannula head (dome d 10, base plate, side septum recess d 3.6, two latch notches, hose barb d 1.6, magnet pocket d 2.1 x 1.05 in the rear lug). Glue a d2x1 N52 magnet (CA drop) and press a punched d2 silicone plug into the septum bore. Dimensions follow cannula.* placeholders (TODO-MEASURE).
